Map Name: Rezzurection
Version: 1.2
Creators: iMaxMC & pashaabiceps
Day or night?: Day
YAML: Dont Finished, Ask me.
Skype: max.sus.gabriel  , only MapDevs Please
Download: ask me on skype for the Link.

==========Map Features==========
1 Spawn per team
2 Wools per team 
2 Mini-Islands with Anvils and supplys
2 Mini-Islands with Enchanting Tabble
1 Middle (with supplys)
Gold , Iron and a bit of diamond BLOCKS

 64 Wood Oaks 
 64 Glass .( Colour depending your team in)
